I compared the volume of tea production in Taiwan during 2000 and 2023. Three takeaways were:

1.  Nantou County produces the most tea out of all other regions

2.  The north parts of Taiwan used to produce a lot of tea

3.  Most regions don't produce as much compared to 2000

[**Technologies**]{.underline}: R/RStudio, Inkscape, Slope Chart
